$comment: Declared graph-semantics expectations for UVC 1.0. Schema-level accept/reject cases are EXECUTABLE via conformance/schema-assertions.json (campaign/fixtures). The rules below cannot be expressed by JSON Schema (uniqueness across items, graph reachability, variable resolution) and become executable with the campaign composer.

vectors.note: two entries sharing an id refuse by name
an entry no unlock condition can ever satisfy from the initial carryover is refused, not silently hidden
a cycle in the unlock graph refuses naming its members
a var in an unlock expression must name a declared carryover variable
the initial value of every carryover variable conforms to its declared type; enum initial ∈ values
